subject: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@pulsar.ai, Maria Gonzalez <maria@pulsar.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request

Team — looping you in on an upcoming launch request from Pulsar.ai (see attached forecast + MAP). They plan a staged public launch next month and have asked for a short-lived quota uplift during the first 72 hours of ramp. Quick summary of their stated profile:
- Day 0–1: 200 RPS steady (95th p95 request size ~ 1.2k tokens)
- Day 2–3: step-up to ~800 RPS for a 48–72 hour window with peaks to 1.2k RPS sustained for short bursts
- Sequence profile: median sequence length ~ 160 tokens, heavy tail to 2k tokens on long form tasks

Key asks we need to resolve this week:
1) Temporary quota uplift (magnitude + timing) and whether we can carve a bursting envelope without long-lived permanent changes
2) Pre-warm requirements (KV cache & prefix warm) — infra guidance needed on how long ahead to bring caches online for target perf
3) Product clarifications: will Pulsar use streaming + function calls heavily? That changes token counting and batching behavior
4) Routing/fallback: acceptable model-variant fallback if the primary model degrades under load

Attachments: pulsar_forecast_v1.csv, MAP-v0.3.docx
Related: HubSpot deal DEAL-4729 (link below).

Goal: land an operational plan (quota uplift + pre-warm window + fallback) and a canary schedule by EOD Friday so Sales can finalize the launch playbook.

Priyom
Product/Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ops@pulsar.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request

Thanks Priyom — good context. A couple of notes from the commercial side before Infra greenlights anything:
- Pulsar is requesting the uplift as part of their premium launch package; legal has signed SOW language for a temporary uplift (we have flexibility to limit to a 72-hour window) but we need a clear committed runway number to attach to the uplift (they're asking for 4x baseline).
- Please include plan for measuring post-launch token burn so we can reconcile billing vs uplift entitlement.

David — do you need a formal SO or will an Ops ticket + runbook suffice to provision the burst envelope?

Pulsar — can you confirm the exact start time (TZ) of the 72-hour window and whether you expect ramped traffic (linear) or step functions? A single-step burst is harder to absorb than a staged ramp.

—Marissa
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, ops@pulsar.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request

Marissa / Priyom — technical constraints and recommendation: 
- We can support a temporary uplift but recommend limiting to 3x baseline rather than 4x as a conservative operating envelope. 4x introduces higher risk of tail degradation unless we run a 48-hour pre-warm.
- Pre-warm: we need at least 48 hours of traffic shaping (synthetic warmup + cache prefill) to populate KV caches & compilation caches for the large-model paths. Without this, cold-token latency will spike and batching will be inefficient.
- Fallback: we'll point routed traffic to a quantized model variant (q4/8 profile) when p95 latency exceeds 3x baseline for more than 10m. That fallback has lower cost but may change output characteristics — Product should sign off.

Operational asks for Pulsar: provide token distribution (sample prompt set) and an expected ramp schedule (start time + per-hour step). If they can't provide a staged ramp, we want the 48-hour pre-warm window plus a 12-hour rolling-checklist prior to the burst.

I'll create an Ops ticket and a short runbook (INF-3412) and attach recommended batching/kv params.

-David
Director, Infra & Capacity
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ops@pulsar.ai, Maria Gonzalez <maria@pulsar.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 10:00:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request

Thanks — a few product clarifications to help narrow the risk profile:
1) Model behavior: will Pulsar be using function-calling or streaming responses heavily? If yes, we need to treat token billing differently and expect longer open connections which affect connection pooling and routing.
2) Sequence length distribution: please attach 1k sample prompts (anonymized) and mark the % of calls that require >512 tokens. That informs whether the long tail will be dominant.
3) Quality / fallback acceptance criteria: define a measurable acceptance test for the quantized fallback (example: top-level intent preservation via 100-sample eval). Product needs to approve fallback gates before we flip traffic.

Once we have those artifacts we can sign off on the fallback profile and finalize the canary schedule. If Pulsar can't provide samples we can run a conservative canary (10% traffic) for 6 hours prior to full uplift.

Lauren Bishop
Group PM, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pulsar Ops <ops@pulsar.ai>, Maria Gonzalez <maria@pulsar.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 15:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pulsar launch: quota scenario coordination and short-term uplift request

Summary / next steps (agreed):
- Temporary uplift approved: 3x baseline for a 72-hour window, subject to a 48-hour pre-warm period and Product acceptance of the fallback gate.
- Pre-warm: Pulsar to run synthetic warmup + provide a 1k sample prompt set (anonymized) by EOD Thursday so Product can run the 100-sample eval for fallback gating.
- Fallback: infra will configure automatic route to q4.8 variant when p95 latency exceeds 3x baseline for >10m; Product must confirm acceptance criteria in Jira INF-3412.
- Commercial: Marissa to attach the uplift to the SOW (72-hour clause) and reconcile billing after the window with token-level offsets. Deal: DEAL-4729.

Attachments added to the thread: pulsar_launch_runbook.pdf (runbook + checklist), pulsar_forecast_v1.csv, MAP-v0.3.docx
Meeting: I'll schedule a 30-min sync (canary runbook + signoff) for Thu 09:00 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks everyone — will post the invite and update INF-3412 with runbook artifacts.

Priyom
Product/Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
